title: Aggregate tallies never substitute for row-level evidence
summary: Counts, sums and deduplicated tallies are reported with their exact counting rule and coverage fraction, and are never presented as if every underlying row was individually verified.

protected.asset: The evidentiary value of audit and research reports produced by unattended pipelines
protected.failure: An aggregate, for example a unique-message count, is read as per-row verification, so replayed or duplicated rows silently inflate confidence in the result.

rationale: Unattended analysis pipelines summarise: rows read, unique texts, hash matches. Every tally has a counting rule — what was deduplicated, what was kept as a genuine repeat, what could not be classified — and a coverage fraction of rows examined over rows present. Reporting the rule and the coverage keeps an honest distance between 'the aggregate holds' and 'every row was verified'. Transport copies and replays are a known inflation source: they are named and counted as their own class, not silently merged into unique counts.

variants.description: Every reported aggregate carries examined-over-total counts and the deduplication rule that produced it.
A recorded sample of rows is traced from raw input to its aggregate entry, so the counting rule is checkable rather than asserted.

verification.method: Take one report containing aggregates, confirm each aggregate carries its counting rule and coverage fraction, and trace one sampled row from raw input to its aggregate entry.
verification.evidence: The annotated aggregates and the sampled row's trace; not the full dataset.

rollback.method: Drop the annotation requirement; reports remain valid but lose the coverage guarantee.
rollback.safety: Annotation is additive reporting metadata and changes no data.

failure_modes: A unique count is quoted where the input still contains unresolved transport copies.
Hash-matched inputs are described as semantically verified.
Rows that failed parsing vanish from the denominator of the coverage fraction.

hermes_versions.notes: Operational practice control: applies to any reporting pipeline; the range records the builds whose reporting surfaces the procedure was read against.

last_verification.notes: General operational synthesis from recorded practice with private detail removed; no specific public incident is claimed.

references: General operational synthesis from recorded practice; no publicly verifiable incident is cited.
